Samira (CEO): Short weekly note: thanks for the quick cache rollback Friday. Highlights: Private GA next week, a hosted data retention default change, and three operational asks.

Samira (CEO): Private GA timeline: Tue 04:00 UTC start. Canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~48h. Rollback if error-rate > 1.2% or sustained latency > 2x. Carlos owning rollout.

Samira (CEO): Policy change: new workspaces default to 90d retention starting Mon. Ops+Comms: migration guidance + FAQ please.

Samira (CEO): Quick metrics: p50 gen ~62ms, p95 ~210ms, 7d uptime 99.96. Optimize cost -4% WoW; target -6% by Friday.

Jordan (VP Eng): Roger. Freezing infra merges during canary. Will set conservative quantization for first waves.

Priya (VP Product): Docs/changelog on it. We'll add a one-click preserve-180d option for customers who need it.

Carlos (Head of Ops): DeployBot scheduled the canary (deploy-2865432100-privga) -> start 2026-04-07T04:00:00Z. I'll post playbook in #release-war-room 2h before start.

Eli (Comms): Drafts ready at https://redwood.co/comm-drafts/privga. Holding external until product sign-off.

Samira (CEO): Asks: 1) eng leads confirm owners for cache SLI/alerts, 2) ops to run canary with conservative kernels first 25%, 3) Comms ready to send external note after sign-off. I'll follow up Friday with a scoreboard.

Jordan (VP Eng): Confirmed. Eng-runtime owning cache SLI, eng-sre alerting.

Priya (VP Product): Confirmed. Product owns migration UX and partner slide.

Carlos (Head of Ops): Confirmed. Ops will run conservative canary profile and monitor.

Samira (CEO): Thanks team. If blockers, flag in this thread now.
